content:
Local-first tools keep the durable source close to the person doing the work.
In Castle, Markdown files are authoritative; generated graphs, search indexes,
and databases are replaceable views.

## Practical consequences

1. Notes remain readable without the application.
2. Links such as [the research plan](/note/projects/neighborhood_atlas/research_plan)
   remain explicit in source.
3. Sensitive raw interviews can stay outside publishable summaries.
4. A disposable index can make search fast without becoming a second source of truth.

Noah applies these ideas to the
[Atlas data dictionary](/note/projects/neighborhood_atlas/data_dictionary), especially
the consent and evidence fields.

occurrences.context: He prefers simple exports, reversible transformations, and the local-first approach described in Local-first knowledge.
This follows the logic of Local-first knowledge.
See Data dictionary for the fields and Local-first knowledge for why raw interview material stays on the researcher's device.
